relations: A hand holding a red-purple disc enters from the right and moves leftward over the vacant right pocket.
Fingers lower the disc into the right recess and press it flat against the tray.
As the disc settles, the front LCD time readout advances through several increments.
The hand releases and withdraws rightward, leaving both discs seated in the open tray.
caption: The video showcases a black Sony five-disc CD changer resting on a white surface with its disc tray extended, a yellow-and-black 'ATLANTIC' disc already seated in the left pocket and the right pocket empty, while a white sheet and a teal object sit behind the unit and the front LCD displays track and time readouts. A hand holding a red-and-purple 'Captain Fantastic' disc enters from the right edge and moves the disc leftward and downward over the vacant pocket. The fingers lower it into the right recess and press gently to seat it flat. As the placement proceeds, the LCD time advances through several increments. The hand then releases the disc and withdraws rightward out of the tray area. With the hand gone, both discs occupy the left and right pockets while the tray remains open.
